description: Development-set real 10-K filings used to design and re-analyse the answer-semantics resolvers. This is not an independent confirmation cohort: the untouched prospective cohort is fixtures/answer_semantics/holdout_plan.json. Chosen for layout, fiscal-calendar, unit, restatement and reporting-scope variation. The Coca-Cola FY2022 and 3M FY2018 filings are the two known regression cases from the FOCUS review; they are included alongside filings never used to develop the resolver.
rights: SEC EDGAR filings are free to access and reuse under the SEC's published web-access guidance. They are prepared and filed by issuers, not by federal employees, so 17 U.S.C. 105 does not apply and no public-domain status is asserted here. Bytes are fetched at build time and archived under var/ (gitignored); only accessions, URLs, digests and short printed figures are committed, pending source-rights review.
